title: Swe entry systemdesign notes api
question: Design a simple REST API for a note-taking app, where a user can create, read, update, and delete their own notes.
idealAnswer:
Lays out sensible REST endpoints and methods, e.g. POST /notes, GET /notes/:id, GET /notes, PUT or PATCH /notes/:id, DELETE /notes/:id

Defines a reasonable data model for a note: id, owner/user id, title, body, created_at, updated_at at minimum

Addresses that a user should only be able to access their own notes, e.g. scoping every query by the authenticated user's id rather than trusting an id in the request

Chooses sensible status codes for each case: 201 on create, 200 on successful read/update, 204 or 200 on delete, 404 for a note that doesn't exist or isn't theirs

Bonus: mentions pagination for listing notes once a user has many, rather than always returning the full list

followUps: How would you handle a user trying to fetch a note by id that belongs to someone else, and why does that status code choice matter?
